T: One BB gun wish. One very big turkey.
D: A boy in 1940s Indiana wants just one thing for Christmas: a BB gun.
P: Serve the duck when Ralphie and the family first visit the department store Santa.
S: Small baked beef and onion meatballs, meatloaf in bite form
Beef mince, breadcrumbs soaked in milk, grated onion and egg mixed lightly, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar and back in for 5.
piped mash rounds baked crisp with sour cream, bacon and cheddar, eat like a little piggy

Fluffy mash piped into rounds, baked crisp on top, loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives, perfect finger food without the face-down approach. Boil 1kg potatoes, pass through a ricer and beat with 60g butter, 80ml hot milk, 1 egg yolk and salt. Pipe 20 rounds onto a lined tray and sprinkle with 80g grated cheddar. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until golden. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Top each with a little sour cream from 150g, bacon and chopped chives.
Breadsticks wound in fishnet style prosciutto, whipped ricotta to dip
Grissini wrapped in prosciutto in a criss-cross pattern like fishnet, stood up in a glass, with a small bowl of whipped ricotta.
M: Shredded roast duck legs, steamed pancakes, cucumber, spring onion, hoisin
Duck legs salted overnight, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes until crisp, shredded, wrapped in steamed pancakes with cucumber, spring onion and hoisin.
Christmas dinner before the Bumpus hounds get it

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy and sliced, with stuffing, cranberry sauce, mash, buttered greens and gravy, guarded closely from the neighbours' dogs. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 60g salt and 30g sugar. Rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C for 75 minutes to 70C, then rest 20 minutes. Bake 150g breadcrumbs with 1 sautéed onion, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Make gravy with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Buttery vanilla cutout cookies in stars and trees
Butter and sugar creamed, egg and vanilla, flour mixed in, chilled, rolled and cut into stars and trees, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with coloured royal icing.
K: Malt powder, cocoa and vanilla ice cream blended with milk, in tall glasses
Malted milk powder and cocoa whisked into cold milk, blended with a scoop of vanilla ice cream until frothy.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk. Grate the onion.
Mix lightly with the mince, egg and salt, then roll into 20 balls.
Bake at 200C until cooked through.
Mix the tomato sauce with the brown sugar, brush over and bake a few minutes more.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk. Grate the onion.
Mix lightly with the plant-based mince, egg and salt, then roll into 20 balls.
Bake at 200C on a lined tray until browned and hot through.
Mix the tomato sauce with the brown sugar, brush over and bake a few minutes more.
Cut the prosciutto into long thin strips and wind criss-cross around the breadsticks like fishnet.
Stand them up in a tall glass.
Whip the ricotta with salt and pepper and serve in a small bowl alongside.

veg.n: Fishnet zucchini wrapped breadsticks and ricotta

steps.text: Shave the zucchini into long thin ribbons with a peeler, brush with the oil and dust with the paprika.
Chargrill the ribbons for about 1 minute a side until soft and bendy, then cool.
Cut the ribbons into thin strips and wind criss-cross around the breadsticks like fishnet.
Stand them up in a tall glass.
Whip the ricotta with salt and pepper and serve in a small bowl alongside.
Salt the duck legs and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 180C until the skin is crisp, then shred the meat.
Cut the cucumber and spring onions into matchsticks.
Steam the pancakes.
Serve the duck with the pancakes, vegetables and hoisin for rolling at the table.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cucumber and spring onions up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast the mushrooms just before serving so they stay crisp

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, soy sauce, five spice and salt and roast at 220C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Cut the cucumber and spring onions into matchsticks.
Steam the pancakes.
Serve the mushrooms with the pancakes, vegetables and hoisin for rolling at the table.

dishes.make_ahead: Dough up to 2 days, iced cookies up to 4 days

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar, add the egg and vanilla, then mix in the flour.
Chill the dough.
Roll 5mm thick and cut stars and trees.
Bake at 180C until just golden.
Mix the icing sugar with a little water and colouring and ice the cooled cookies.

dishes.make_ahead: Whisk the malt and cocoa into the milk up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; blend with the ice cream to order

steps.text: Whisk the malt and cocoa into the cold milk.
Blend with the ice cream until frothy.
Pour into four tall glasses.

s.note: Small baked beef and onion meatballs, meatloaf in bite form
s.how: Soak 40g breadcrumbs in 60ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, half a grated brown onion, 1 egg and salt. Roll into 20 balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp tomato sauce with 1 tbsp brown sugar, brush over and bake 5 minutes more.

s.note: Breadsticks wound in fishnet style prosciutto, whipped ricotta to dip
s.how: Cut 100g prosciutto into long thin strips and wind them criss-cross around 16 breadsticks like fishnet. Stand them up in a tall glass. Whip 200g ricotta with a pinch of salt and pepper and serve in a small bowl beside them.

m.note: Shredded roast duck legs, steamed pancakes, cucumber, spring onion, hoisin
m.how: Salt 4 duck legs and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes until crisp, then shred. Steam 20 Chinese pancakes for 3 minutes. Serve with 1 Lebanese cucumber and 4 spring onions cut into matchsticks and 120ml hoisin sauce for rolling at the table.

w.note: Buttery vanilla cutout cookies in stars and trees
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 120g caster sugar, add 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 280g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick, cut stars and trees and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Mix 250g icing sugar with a little water and food colouring and ice the cooled cookies.

d.note: Malt powder, cocoa and vanilla ice cream blended with milk, in tall glasses
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp cocoa into 800ml cold milk. Blend with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, about 300ml, until frothy. Pour into four tall glasses.
